camps.title: Traidhos 冬季英语营 · 泰国清迈

en.title: Traidhos Winter English Camp · Chiang Mai
en.format: Day camp · daily 08:45–15:30 · a parent must stay in Chiang Mai with the child; accommodation is arranged by you
en.summary:
The camp is run by PREM International School, and we are its authorised agent. The four sessions have different themes, run five days each, and you can book just one. Teacher–student ratio is 1:10 (1:7 for farm and archery). English classes use Cambridge-system materials, with grouping by ability after an entry assessment.
Source: official camp information, updated 2026.09; the camp's official announcements prevail.
en.excludes: Flights, visa, accommodation itself, breakfast and dinner, daily transport
en.includes: Lunch and daily snacks, lessons, activity materials, camp souvenir, accident insurance, completion certificate
en.service_fee: Registration service fee ¥230 / person · optional help booking accommodation +¥100

en.title: Dulwich College Bangkok × TEEMS Global Winter Camp · Bangkok
en.format: Full-day camp · Mon–Fri 08:00–14:30 · ages 4–6 follow a play-based programme
